draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 5.93, the 163rd-best grade among 259 2021 draftees and 24th of 35 at WR. He went 179th overall, close to where his grade ranked. Published comparison: Quincy Enunwa. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: 574 receiving yards in 2020, 23rd of 35 WRs in his class with stats.
